title: You-Chen Chen
text:
I am a Ph.D. student in Political Science at the University of Houston.
My research interests lie at the intersection of political behavior, political psychology, public opinion, and legislative politics. I am particularly interested in how citizens evaluate political representatives and how political identities, policy experiences, and political information shape public attitudes and democratic accountability.
My research employs quantitative methods, survey experiments, and text analysis to study political representation, public opinion, and policy feedback.
